items.title: CDC Steven M. Teutsch Prevention Effectiveness (PE) Fellowship 2027 (Paid)
items.summary: Deadline: January 8, 2027 Applications are open for the CDC Steven M. Teutsch Prevention Effectiveness (PE) Fellowship 2027. CDC’s Steven M. Teutsch Prevention Effectiveness (PE) Fellowship is a two-year, post-doctoral, applied training fellowship. It addresses public health demand for quantitative policy analysis, health economics-based inquiry, integrative health services research, and rigorous decision modeling. The Traditional [...]
